meta.title: The Violet Hour — a candle and scent shop on Purple
meta.description: A WooCommerce store for a small-batch candle and scent studio in Edinburgh, on Automattic's Purple theme with its Libre Baskerville + Figtree type. A tapers hero, the season's candles, category doors, a studio band, a gift box, a map, an Our story page and a Visit page, all built with gogh around Woo's own shop, product and cart pages.
meta.author: jamiemarsland
